cfg.reader: a customer whose order arrived nine days late
cfg.task: a customer-support reply (under 110 words) that apologises, explains the delay honestly (a warehouse move), gives a 20% refund without being asked, and does not ask the customer to do anything

source.text:
Dear Customer,

We are truly sorry your order arrived nine days late. During that time we were moving to a new warehouse, which slowed packing and shipping far beyond our normal standards. That is entirely on us.

We have issued a 20% refund to your original payment method. It should appear within 3-5 business days.

Thank you for your patience, and we are grateful for your support.

Sincerely,
Maya, Customer Support
